example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো চাষাভুষো, শহরের চালচলন বুঝবে না।
চাষাভুষোদের মতো কথা বলিস না, একটু শিক্ষিত হয়ে কথা বল।
example_sentences_in_english: He's just a country bumpkin; he won't understand city ways.
Don't talk like a yokel; speak more educatedly.
note: This idiom highlights the cultural divide between rural and urban Bengal, often used pejoratively.
